question: Which patients in the deep-chart panel have diabetes by their labs but no diabetes diagnosis? Definition: Deep-chart patients (data_segment deep_chart) without a diabetes diagnosis with at least two HbA1c results >= 6.5%. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

Of our hypertensive patients with a blood pressure on file in 2029, what share had their last reading under control? Definition: Persons 18-85 on 2029-12-31 with hypertension documented by then and >= 1 delivered BP in 2029: share whose last 2029 reading is < 140/90, percent. Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many observation stays did we have in 2028? Definition: Observation stays starting in 2028: distinct person and service date with a non-voided claim line with revenue code 0762 or HCPCS G0378/G0379. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

What were the top five reasons people were admitted to the hospital in 2028? Definition: Top 5 principal-diagnosis ICD-10 3-character categories of inpatient stays admitted in 2028, with stay counts. Inpatient stay = distinct person and admission date on non-voided institutional payer claims with bill type 011x, final adjudication. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

What are the top denial reason codes this year (2029)? Definition: All patients. Top 5 CARC codes by distinct payer claims with a denied or denied_upheld adjudication dated 2029 carrying that CARC (a claim counts once per CARC, so an upheld appeal repeating it is not recounted); table keys are the CARC as delivered, e.g. "CO-16". Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many duplicate-claim denials did we get in 2028? Definition: Distinct payer claims with a denial carrying CARC CO-18 (exact duplicate) whose denial adjudication is dated 2028 (an upheld appeal does not count again). Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

What's our breast cancer screening rate for 2028? Definition: BCS: women 52-74 on 2028-12-31 with a delivered primary enrollment span in 2028; met if a mammogram in 2027-2028 (paid payer or provider claim line 77065/77066/77067, or an EHR mammography screening result). Percent. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

What share of diabetics had poorly controlled A1c in 2029? Definition: HBD poor control: persons 18-75 with diabetes documented by 2029-12-31 and a primary span in 2029; poor if the last delivered 2029 HbA1c is > 9% or there is none. Percent. Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many medications did clinicians stop where the stop is only written in a note? Definition: Members whose clinician stopped a maintenance drug class with the decision recorded only in free-text notes (no discontinued order or list entry). Scope: population members (patients.data_segment claims_only or claims_plus_ehr; duplicate charts count as their person). Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many patients restarted a medication after going more than 90 days without it? Definition: Persons with a gap of more than 90 days between the end of one fill's supply and the next fill of the same class (a restart), through as_of. Gap days = next fill date - (fill date + days_supply), between consecutive fills of the class; every drug class counts, including acute classes such as antibiotics. Fills = paid payer pharmacy claims not reversed or recouped; drug class from NDC/RxNorm (drug catalog) or ingredient name. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many members switched health plans during the period? Definition: Persons with primary coverage from more than one payer across their delivered spans. Delivered enrollment spans (primary coverage; Medigap and COB secondary excluded) and delivered death records. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many Medicare beneficiaries were assigned to our ACO at the start of 2029? Definition: Persons alive with an active medicare_ffs or dual_ffs span on 2029-01-01. Delivered enrollment spans (primary coverage; Medigap and COB secondary excluded) and delivered death records. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many ER visits in 2028 were for mental health? Definition: ED visits in 2028 whose ED claim principal diagnosis is a mental or behavioral code (F00-F99). ED visit = distinct person and service date with a non-voided payer claim for an ED service (professional place of service 23, or an institutional line with revenue code 045x). Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many PHQ-9s flagged thoughts of self-harm? Definition: Delivered PHQ-9 results with item 9 (thoughts of self-harm) positive, through as_of. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How far out are patients booking appointments? Definition: Mean days from booking to slot for appointments with a 2029 slot (booking = the appointment's recorded lead time, else its first delivered version). Appointments: each appointment_id once, in its latest delivered version, from every scheduling feed; slot date = slot start or scheduled date; attended counts as fulfilled and rescheduled as cancelled. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How long are our appointment slots on average? Definition: Mean slot length in minutes over appointments with a 2029 slot that state one. Appointments: each appointment_id once, in its latest delivered version, from every scheduling feed; slot date = slot start or scheduled date; attended counts as fulfilled and rescheduled as cancelled. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many people started a statin for the first time in 2029? Definition: Persons who became new users of a statin in 2029. New user = a fill of the class with no fill of that class in the preceding 180 days, and at least 180 days of data (from 2026-09-01) before it. Each person is counted once, in the period of their FIRST such fill: a person whose first new-user fill falls in an earlier period is not counted again when they restart after a later gap of more than 180 days. Fills = paid payer pharmacy claims not reversed or recouped; drug class from NDC/RxNorm (drug catalog) or ingredient name. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

Among AFib patients, how many are on a DOAC versus warfarin? Definition: Persons with documented atrial fibrillation (I48) by anticoagulant class filled through as_of (a person can be in both). Table keys: "DOAC" (apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, edoxaban) and "warfarin". Documented = ICD-10 code on a paid payer claim, an EHR problem-list entry or an EHR encounter diagnosis, any date through as_of. Fills = paid payer pharmacy claims not reversed or recouped; drug class from NDC/RxNorm (drug catalog) or ingredient name. Scope: every patient in the (sampled) warehouse, duplicate charts counted as their person. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.
How many lab results were corrected after they were first reported? Definition: All patients. Lab results with result_status corrected. Use data received as of 2030-05-27.

How many of our records were later restated by a newer version? Definition: All patients. Source records that a later record supersedes (supersedes_record_id points to them). Use data received as of 2030-05-27.
